column1: # FrameScript C->Lua glue-event catalog of the 3.3.5a client (WoW.exe build 12340): eventId -> name.
# Source: the 0x29-slot event-name pointer array at 0xb6aff8, filled by 0x4dbc70..0x4dbe0a.
# The glue manager's Resume (0x4da5f0) hands it to the FrameScript event registry at 0x81b5f0 in place of the world table, so a glue event's id names a different event in-game.
